requirements.R1: Only the originating optimizer contributes mintable accepted work
requirements.R2: Imported accepted optima strictly improve the committed domain champion
requirements.R3: Accepted optimum identities cannot receive work twice
requirements.R4: Accepted payload changes invalidate transaction integrity
requirements.R5: Archive references recover exact parameters without losing consensus fields
requirements.R6: Restart and peer synchronization recover committed champion state
requirements.R7: Fork candidates are validated before local rollback
requirements.R8: Independent nodes converge to identical blocks, not locally reminted copies
requirements.R9: Only a newly committed block migrates a champion into an optimizer
requirements.R10: Dashboard joins compact acceptance records, verifies archived metrics and discloses invalid historical acceptances

constraints: No live services, history or fitness changes
No private data or TEST reads
next_allowed_actions: Let the bounded autonomous controller verify every new block
Preserve physical candidate archives and warehouse readback
Close all four H4 terminals before the H72 successor
Treat all tuning results as development evidence until prospective evaluation
